articles.title_en: Quantifying Threshold Manipulation in the Presence of Rounding: The Case of Lead Monitoring in US Drinking Water
articles.title_cn: 存在四舍五入情况下的阈值操纵量化：美国饮用水铅监测案例
articles.abstract_en: Many laws and economic actions depend on thresholds. As a consequence, threshold manipulation is a common concern in a variety of settings. Existing methods for detecting and quantifying threshold manipulation assume a continuous counterfactual distribution absent manipulation. This assumption is violated in the presence of rounding, which is prevalent in many applications and distinct from manipulation. This paper develops methods for testing and quantifying threshold manipulation when rounding is a prominent feature of the data. We demonstrate the usefulness of our approach in an empirical application examining threshold manipulation in lead monitoring under the US Safe Drinking Water Act. (JEL C24, I28, K32, Q53, Q58)
articles.abstract_cn: 许多法律和经济行为依赖于阈值。因此，阈值操纵在各种情境中是一个常见的关注点。现有的检测和量化阈值操纵的方法假设在没有操纵的情况下存在连续的反事实分布。这一假设在存在四舍五入的情况下被违反，而四舍五入在许多应用中普遍存在，且与操纵不同。本文开发了在数据具有显著四舍五入特征时测试和量化阈值操纵的方法。我们在一个实证应用中展示了我们方法的实用性，该应用考察了美国《安全饮用水法》下铅监测中的阈值操纵。(JEL C24, I28, K32, Q53, Q58)

articles.title_en: A Theory of Fair CEO Pay
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies executive pay with fairness concerns: If the CEO's wage falls below a perceived fair share of output, he suffers disutility that is increasing in the discrepancy. Fairness concerns do not always lead to fair wages; instead, the firm threatens the CEO with unfair wages for low output to induce effort. The contract sometimes involves performance-vesting equity: The CEO is paid a constant share of output if it is sufficiently high and zero otherwise. Even without moral hazard, the contract features pay-for-performance to address fairness concerns and ensure participation. This rationalizes pay-for-performance even if effort incentives are unnecessary. (JEL D63, D82, D86, G34, M12, M52)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究带有公平关注的行政薪酬：如果CEO的工资低于感知到的公平产出份额，他将遭受与差距递增的负效用。公平关注并不总是导致公平工资；相反，公司以低产出的不公平工资威胁CEO以诱导努力。合同有时涉及业绩归属股权：如果产出足够高，CEO获得产出的固定份额，否则为零。即使没有道德风险，合同也包含按业绩付酬以解决公平关注并确保参与。这合理化了即使努力激励不必要时的按业绩付酬。(JEL D63, D82, D86, G34, M12, M52)

articles.title_en: Exogenous Exits, Market Structure, and Equilibrium Contracts in Health Care
articles.title_cn: 外生退出、市场结构与医疗保健中的均衡合同
articles.abstract_en: This paper quantifies the causal effects of exogenous health insurer exits on contract structure and health care market outcomes, proposing market concentration as a likely mechanism for these effects. Leveraging the termination of the largest health insurer in Colombia, I find that the use of fee-for-service contracts increased after the termination relative to capitation contracts. Treatment effects are larger in markets with higher provider than insurer concentration at baseline. Results suggest that equilibrium contracts place the financial risk on insurers in markets where providers have higher bargaining leverage. (JEL D86, G22, I13, I18, O15, O16)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文量化了外生健康保险公司退出对合同结构和医疗保健市场结果的因果效应，并提出市场集中度作为这些效应的可能机制。利用哥伦比亚最大健康保险公司的终止，我发现相对于按人头付费合同，终止后按服务收费合同的使用增加了。在基线时提供者集中度高于保险公司集中度的市场中，处理效应更大。结果表明，在提供者拥有更高议价能力的市场中，均衡合同将财务风险置于保险公司身上。(JEL D86, G22, I13, I18, O15, O16)

articles.abstract_en: This paper provides a critical input into crafting effective firearms policy: an understanding of consumer demand for guns. We estimate individual-level price sensitivity and substitution patterns across gun types using stated-choice experiments. We find that potential firearm buyers are price insensitive overall but that first-time buyers are the most price sensitive. We also estimate considerable substitution from semiautomatic long guns (sometimes called “assault weapons”) to handguns, which are associated with more crimes per gun. (JEL D12, D72, K23, K42, L51, L64, M31)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文为制定有效的枪支政策提供了一个关键输入：对枪支消费者需求的理解。我们利用陈述性选择实验估计了个人层面的价格敏感性和不同枪支类型间的替代模式。我们发现，潜在的枪支购买者总体上对价格不敏感，但首次购买者最为价格敏感。我们还估计出从半自动长枪（有时称为“攻击性武器”）到手枪的显著替代，而手枪与每支枪相关的犯罪更多。（JEL D12, D72, K23, K42, L51, L64, M31）

articles.title_en: Discrimination in the Formation of Academic Networks: A Field Experiment on #EconTwitter
articles.title_cn: 学术网络形成中的歧视：一项关于#EconTwitter的实地实验
articles.abstract_en: This paper documents discrimination in the formation of professional networks among academic economists. We created 80 bot accounts that claim to be PhD students differing in three characteristics: gender (male or female), race (Black or White), and university affiliation (top- or lower-ranked). The bots randomly followed 6,920 users in the #EconTwitter community. Follow-back rates were 12 percent higher for White students compared to Black students, 21 percent higher for students from top-ranked universities compared to those from lower-ranked institutions, and 25 percent higher for female compared to male students. Notably, the racial gap persists even among students from top-ranked institutions. (JEL A11, C93, I23, J15, J16, Z13)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文记录了经济学家专业网络形成中的歧视现象。我们创建了80个声称是博士生的机器人账户，这些账户在三个特征上有所不同：性别（男性或女性）、种族（黑人或白人）以及大学隶属关系（顶尖或较低排名）。这些机器人随机关注了#EconTwitter社区中的6,920名用户。回关率方面，白人学生比黑人学生高12%，顶尖大学学生比排名较低院校学生高21%，女性学生比男性学生高25%。值得注意的是，即使在顶尖大学的学生中，种族差距依然存在。（JEL A11, C93, I23, J15, J16, Z13）

articles.title_en: Interpreting TSLS Estimators in Information Provision Experiments
articles.title_cn: 解读信息提供实验中的TSLS估计量
articles.abstract_en: In information provision experiments, researchers often estimate the causal effects of beliefs on actions using two-stage least squares (TSLS). This paper formalizes exclusion and monotonicity conditions that ensure that TSLS recovers a positive-weighted average of causal effects. We assess common TSLS estimators for both passive and active control designs from the literature; we find that two commonly used passive control estimators generally allow for negative weights. The choice of passive control estimator affects the magnitude and significance of estimates in simulations and in an empirical application. We give practical recommendations for addressing these issues. (JEL C26, C90, D21, D83, E23)
articles.abstract_cn: 在信息提供实验中，研究者常使用两阶段最小二乘法（TSLS）估计信念对行为的因果效应。本文形式化了确保TSLS恢复正加权平均因果效应的排除和单调性条件。我们评估了文献中被动和主动控制设计的常见TSLS估计量；发现两种常用的被动控制估计量通常允许负权重。被动控制估计量的选择影响模拟和实证应用中的估计值大小及显著性。我们给出了解决这些问题的实用建议。（JEL C26, C90, D21, D83, E23）

articles.title_en: Health Effects of Cousin Marriage: Evidence from US Genealogical Records
articles.title_cn: 表亲婚姻的健康效应：来自美国族谱记录的证据
articles.abstract_en: Cousin marriage rates are high in many countries today. While previous studies have documented increased risks of infant and child mortality, we provide the first estimate of the effect of such marriages on life expectancy throughout adulthood. By studying couples married over a century ago, we can observe their offspring across the entire lifespan. US genealogical data allow us to identify children whose parents were first cousins and compare their years of life to the offspring of their parents' siblings. Marrying a cousin leads to more than a two-year reduction in age-five life expectancy, compounding the documented early-life effects. (JEL I12, J12, J13, N31, N32)
articles.abstract_cn: 当今许多国家的表亲婚姻率很高。虽然先前的研究记录了婴儿和儿童死亡风险的增加，但我们首次估计了此类婚姻对成年期预期寿命的影响。通过研究一个多世纪前结婚的夫妇，我们可以观察他们的后代在整个生命周期中的情况。美国族谱数据使我们能够识别父母为第一代堂表亲的子女，并将其寿命与其父母兄弟姐妹的后代进行比较。与表亲结婚导致五岁预期寿命减少超过两年，加剧了已记录的早期生命影响。(JEL I12, J12, J13, N31, N32)

articles.title_en: Consumer-Financed Fiscal Stimulus: Evidence from Digital Coupons in China
articles.abstract_en: In 2020, local governments in China began issuing digital coupons to stimulate spending in targeted categories such as restaurants and supermarkets. Using data from a large e-commerce platform and a bunching estimation approach, we find that the coupons caused large increases in spending of 3.1–3.2 yuan per yuan spent by the government. The large spending responses do not come from substitution away from nontargeted spending categories or from short-run intertemporal substitution. To rationalize these results, we develop a dynamic consumption model showing how coupons' minimum spending thresholds create temporary notches that lead to large spending responses. (JEL D15, E21, H72, L81, O18, P25, P36)
